s: During which Five Year Plan was the Emergency clamped, new elections took place and the Janata Party was elected?
x: The scheduled period of Fifth Five Year Plan was 1974-79. During fifth Plan, the Emergency was clamped, new elections took place and the Janta Party was elected. The final Draft of Fifth Plan was prepared and launched by D.P. Dhar in the backdrop of economic crisis arising out of run-away inflation fuelled by hike in oil prices and failure of the Govt. takeover of the wholesale trade in wheat. It proposed to achieve two main objectives : 'removal of poverty' (Garibi Hatao) and 'attainment of self reliance'. After promulgation of Emergency in 1975, the emphasis shifted to the implementation of Prime Minister's 20 Point Programme. Fifth Plan was relegated to the background and when Janta Party came to power the Plan was terminated in 1978, one year before the scheduled period.

s: In which of the following Five Year Plans the Women's Component Plan was introduced as a major strategy?
x: The notion of Women's Component Plan (WCP) had entered the planning process in the Seventh Plan with the initiation of a special mechanism to monitor 27 beneficiary oriented schemes for women. However, the Ninth Five Year Plan (1997-2002) marked a significant progress in this regard. The notion of WCP, as it was adopted in the Ninth Plan, earmarked a clear, unconditional minimum quantum of funds/ benefits for women in the schemes run by all Ministries/ Departments that were perceived to be ‘women-related’ and thereby recognized empowerment. Under WCP, both Central as well as State Governments were required to ensure that ‘‘not less than 30 percent of the funds/benefits are ear-marked for women under the various schemes of the ‘women-related’ Ministries/Departments’’.

s: Which of the following pairs (Plan – actual growth rate) is correctly matched?

s: What was the approximate GDP growth rate of India in 1950-51?
x: GDP grew about 3.6% in 1950-51. 1.1% was the growth of 1990-91, 2.1% was the First Plan's target, and -5.2% (not +5.2%) was the contraction of 1979.

s: What was the average growth over the First to Eleventh Plans, against roughly 1 per cent before Independence?
x: Plan-period growth averaged about 4.5%; agriculture grew 2-3% and industry about 6-8%.

s: Which of the following plans recorded the lowest actual GDP growth?
x: The Third Plan recorded actual growth of about 2.2 per cent, the lowest among the listed plans.

s: Leaving aside the Covid-19 contraction of 2020-21, in which year did India record its lowest GDP growth since 1961?
x: 1979 recorded the lowest growth since 1961, about -5.2%, owing to drought and the second oil shock. 1965-66 and 1972-73 were other negative years but less severe, and 1991-92 grew below 1% but did not contract as sharply. Only the pandemic year 2020-21 (-5.8%) was worse.

s: What was the actual average annual growth rate achieved during the Eighth Five Year Plan?
x: The Eighth Plan (1992-97) achieved 6.8% growth against a target of 5.6%.

x: GDP grew about 4% in 2002-03 (poor monsoon) and 8.2% in 2003-04.

x: The Twelfth Plan recorded GDP growth of about 6.7% a year; per capita NNI grew about 5.3%.

x: The Eleventh Plan achieved 8.0% growth against a 9% target, the highest of all plans.

x: The highest average growth came in 2004-05 to 2012-13, with a boom peak of about 8.5% in 2003-08.

x: The Approach Paper proposed 9%, but the NDC in December 2012 approved a target of 8%.

x: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 names three economic regions: Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Tirupati. Kurnool is not one of them.

x: Srisailam construction began in 1960 and the project opened in 1981.

x: General Category States got 30% grant and 70% loan; Special Category States got 90 : 10.

s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, what weight did per capita income carry?
x: Population had 60%, per capita income 25%, and fiscal performance and special problems 7.5% each.

s: In which year did the Five Year Plan system in India end?
x: Five Year Plans ended in 2017, though plan-style credit and regional planning continue.

s: During the Eleventh Plan, Andhra Pradesh's industry grew by 7.26 per cent. What was its target?
x: In the Eleventh Plan, AP's industry grew 7.26% against a 10% target; GSDP grew 5.28% against 9.5%.

x: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 was launched on 13 December 2024, aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047.

s: What credit plan for Andhra Pradesh did NABARD's State Focus Paper 2026-27 project?
x: NABARD's AP State Focus Paper 2026-27 put the credit plan at Rs 5.11 lakh crore, about 20% higher.

s: Construction of the Srisailam power project in Andhra Pradesh began in 1960. In which year was it opened?
x: Srisailam construction began in 1960 and the project was opened in 1981.

s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, the population of which Census was used?
x: The Gadgil-Mukherjee formula (1991) gave 60% weight to population as per the 1971 Census.

s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, what weight was given to fiscal performance?
x: Weights: population 60%, per capita income 25%, fiscal performance 7.5%, special problems 7.5%.

s: After whom is the Prakasam Barrage on the Krishna river at Vijayawada named?
x: The barrage is named after Tanguturi Prakasam, the first Chief Minister of Andhra State.

s: During which period was the present Prakasam Barrage across the Krishna at Vijayawada built?
x: The present barrage was built in 1954-57, replacing the old anicut of 1852-55.
